name: Advanced Power Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Advanced Power Electronics Co., Ltd., founded in 1998 and headquartered in Zhubei City, Taiwan, is a global provider of power semiconductor components. The company serves markets across Europe, Africa, Asia, Australia, North America, and South America with its diverse product offerings. These include a variety of power MOSFETs, super junctions, and IGBTs, as well as an array of power integrated circuits such as LDOs, DDRs with reset functions, and load switches. APEC also extends its expertise through comprehensive testing services. Their components are crucial for numerous applications, including networking equipment, LED lighting, LCD/LED televisions, switching power systems, motherboards (MB), and notebook computers. Consequently, the company's solutions are integral to the computing, consumer electronics, display, communications, and industrial sectors.
